notes: Posted 4 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING' (objective 'Set Your Corse for Alderaan' posted above it): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses ('Prepared Defense'), A Million Voices Crying Out, Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO') and Imperial Decree; these count toward the 60. A Million Voices Crying Out is taken as the starting Effect, as on the author's later version (DeckTech 17607).

The title's '62 cards' is the poster's count including two Commence Primary Ignition retrieved with A Million Voices Crying Out. The list itself totals 59 as published: 'RED CARDS (10)' lists 9 cards.
Posted '"      " Ozzel', '"      " Chiraneau', '"       " Piett' (ditto marks under 'Admiral Motti') dested Admiral Ozzel, Admiral Chiraneau and Admiral Piett.

Posted 'FS Executor' dested Flagship Executor (Death Star II starship); 'Death Squd Star Destroyer' Death Squadron Star Destroyer; 'Chimeria' Chimaera; 'Tryant' Tyrant; 'Zuckass in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Dengar in Ship' Dengar In Punishing One.

Posted "Vader's Saber" dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere; the posted name matches it word for word); 'Jade's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; "Maul's Saber" Maul's Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Com. Merrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'Capt. Godherdt' Captain Godherdt; 'DS Gunner' Death Star Gunner; 'CPI' Commence Primary Ignition; 'A Day Long Remebered' A Day Long Remembered.

Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Death Star: Detention Block Control Room, Yavin 4, Hoth and Sullust dested their Dark pages. The strategy says the deck should also have Kuat and Kuat Star Drive, which he did not own; they are not in the list.
